svg.title: Indian near-equatorial statistical current classification experiment
svg.desc: Two native OSCAR columns over1995-2016 have three similar leading statistical patterns: an equatorial semiannual pattern, a northern annual pattern peaking at the retained data edge, and a southern annual pattern near5S. Solid and dashed lines identify the two columns. Northern hatching marks incomplete observations, not land. Colored latitude bands are source classification context, not physical current boundaries. Principal component coefficients are not local current speeds. Neither current identity nor physical width is admitted. Numerical values, fifteen fit comparisons and missing support are provided in the companion JSON and plan.
